info.name: CI Backend API
info.description:
API endpoints for the FixPortal CI Dashboard Backend service.

Setup:
1. Set `baseUrl` to `http://localhost:5000/api` (local) or your deployed production backend URL.
2. Set `adminKey` to the value of `Admin:AdminKey` configuration.
3. The public snapshot is unauthenticated; the admin snapshot requires the `X-Admin-Key` header.

variable.description: Base URL of the CI Backend API (including /api).

request.description: Get the public dashboard snapshot containing CI project status. Private repositories are automatically stripped unless explicitly exposed to guests in configuration.
Get the full dashboard snapshot including private repositories. Protected by a shared key passed as X-Admin-Key.
Get backend service health status, including GitHub API credential check.
